messages:
Kara (ENG Manager): FYI planning to convert Jordan RWI-2077 from IC to Engineering Manager, effective 2026-07-01. Need quick clarification: comp form, payroll cutoff, benefits enrollment, and Slack/org sync. Who should I loop in?
Marta (People Ops): congrats to Jordan! :tada: Owners: people-ops handles comp-change intake + benefits; hiring-ops updates HRIS/title/headcount; payroll handles proration/retro. If equity changes needed loop in Grants and Finance.
Kara (ENG Manager): Jordan's refresh was scheduled 2026-09-01. Any immediate impact there? Also bonus eligibility was based on March cutoff.
Marta (People Ops): refresh schedule unaffected by title change unless you request a grant amendment. Bonus eligibility for the closed cycle is locked at 2026-03-31, so no retro change to that cycle. Future cycles will consider new manager level.
Dmitri (Payroll): payroll runs 1st & 15th. For a 7/1 effective, approvals + HRIS update must be completed by 2026-06-18 17:00 PT to reflect in 7/1 payroll. Otherwise we process retro in the subsequent cycle.
Kara (ENG Manager): what's the proration method?
Dmitri (Payroll): calendar days in pay period. Example: effective 7/1 with timely approvals -> new base applies for 1st-15th pay segment in July. Late approvals == retro.
Theo (Hiring Ops): no headcount change needed. I'll file HRIS ticket HRIS-5233 to update title/manager and org mapping. Sync to Slack/org tools usually within 24 hrs after HRIS change.
Kara (ENG Manager): Marta 1) where to submit comp-change and 2) what fields are critical?
Marta (People Ops): submit at https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/comp-change. Pick "role conversion", attach job spec + justification. Critical fields: new_base, new_band, effective_date, PRORATE_FLAG, evidence_docs. Approval chain: manager -> director -> finance -> people-ops.
Jordan (IC -> Eng Manager): quick Q: do I need to re-enroll dependents if I switch to manager perks?
Marta (People Ops): dependents remain on file. Manager perks (leadership stipend, coaching allowance) are available during a 30-day special enrollment from the effective date. If you change medical plan, you may need to confirm dependents on the benefits page. We'll send automated prompts.
Welcome Bot: automated reminder queued: submit comp-change form. Approval flow: manager -> dir -> finance -> people-ops.
Kara (ENG Manager): timeline: I'll submit form today and try to meet payroll cutoff.
Marta (People Ops): checklist for Kara: 1) submit comp-change with attached spec 2) reply when submitted 3) confirm effective_date=2026-07-01 4) let us know if you want an equity amendment.
Kara (ENG Manager): done 1) form submitted, 2) attached spec, 3) set effective_date 7/1.
Marta (People Ops): received and routed. Adding payroll and Theo to the approvals thread.
Dmitri (Payroll): I see the comp-change ticket and HRIS ticket pending. Will queue payroll actions once approvals complete. Note: cutoff times in PT.
Theo (Hiring Ops): I'll update org chart mapping after HRIS patch; Slack display names and manager fields should reflect change within 24 hours.
Jordan (IC -> Eng Manager): thanks! Last Q: any change to eligibility for leadership coaching stipend start date?
Marta (People Ops): stipend eligibility begins on the effective_date if enrollments are completed during the 30-day window. If enrollments missed, next open enrollment applies.
Kara (ENG Manager): great, closing once Payroll confirms retro scheduling.
Dmitri (Payroll): will report back when retro scheduled. :white_check_mark:
